narrative.northStar: A research paper made for the web
narrative.overview:
This document covers `/aipath/` only. It extends the personal site's neutral palette, shared page navigation, and remembered theme. The root `DESIGN.md` continues to govern the portfolio; this route adds the user's approved engineering-paper form.

Serif paragraphs carry the explanation, thin rules divide technical material, and small monospaced labels identify sources and notation. The implementation uses local font stacks, HTML, CSS, inline SVG, and the shared theme script, with no external font dependency.
keyCharacteristics: Narrow serif reading column inside a wider figure column.
Restrained blue links on neutral light and dark surfaces.
Numbered sections, simple line drawings, and source references.
Native disclosure and ordinary page links, without decorative motion.

rules.name: The Shared Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the shared `varun-theme` preference across routes. Follow the system until a valid saved choice exists; preserve the CSS system-theme fallback when JavaScript is absent.

rules.name: The Reading Roles Rule
rules.body: Use serif for explanations, sans for compact interface and technical comparison text, and mono for notation and source metadata.

rules.name: The Paper Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate technical material through whitespace, fine rules, and the existing subtle surface rather than elevation.

dos: Do preserve the shared theme, palette, and active-page navigation across the portfolio and this route.
Do keep reading text narrow and allow figures to use the wider paper column.
Do use semantic figures, tables, links, and native disclosure with visible keyboard focus.
Do keep technical diagrams simple, inline, and legible in both themes and print.
donts: Don't extend this route's paper hierarchy into unrelated portfolio surfaces by default.
Don't replace ordinary navigation links or native disclosure with JavaScript-only controls.
Don't add decorative motion, floating shadows, or external font dependencies to this approved paper treatment.
